```{r echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(jsonlite)

load("rda_files/Publis.Rda")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Uniformisation des titres en sentence case
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_title <- function(x) {

  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1])) {
    return("")
  }

  x <- trimws(as.character(x[1]))

  # Termes dont la casse doit être conservée
  protected_terms <- c(
    "GAMLSS",
    "GLM",
    "GAM",
    "BMS",
    "CAS",
    "EU",
    "APA",
    "R",
    "Tweedie",
    "Sarmanov",
    "AdaBoost",
    "Poisson",
    "Bayesian",
    "Archimedean",
    "Pareto",
    "Gaussian"
  )

  # Tout en minuscules
  x <- tolower(x)

  # Majuscule au début du titre
  substr(x, 1, 1) <- toupper(substr(x, 1, 1))

  # Restaure les termes particuliers
  for (term in protected_terms) {

    x <- gsub(
      paste0("\\b", tolower(term), "\\b"),
      term,
      x,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  }

  x
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Nettoyage des pages
# 121-131 devient 121–131
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_pages <- function(x) {

  if (is.null(x) || length(x) != 1 || is.na(x)) {
    return("")
  }

  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  x <- gsub(
    "([0-9])-([0-9])",
    "\\1–\\2",
    x
  )

  x
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extraction sécurisée d'un champ Crossref simple
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_scalar <- function(x) {

  if (is.null(x) || length(x) != 1 || is.na(x)) {
    return("")
  }

  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  # Évite les valeurs accidentelles du type c(2014, 9)

  if (grepl("^c\\(", x)) {
    return("")
  }

  x
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Récupération des métadonnées Crossref à partir du DOI
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_crossref <- function(doi) {

  doi <- trimws(as.character(doi))

  if (is.na(doi) || doi == "" || doi == "NA") {
    return(NULL)
  }

  url <- paste0(
    "https://api.crossref.org/works/",
    URLencode(doi, reserved = TRUE)
  )

  tryCatch({

    x <- jsonlite::fromJSON(url)$message


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Titre
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    titre <- ""

    if (!is.null(x$title) && length(x$title) > 0) {

      titre <- clean_title(
        x$title[1]
      )
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Auteurs
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    auteurs <- ""

    if (!is.null(x$author) &&
        is.data.frame(x$author) &&
        nrow(x$author) > 0) {

      noms <- character(
        nrow(x$author)
      )

      for (j in seq_len(nrow(x$author))) {

        given <- ""
        family <- ""

        if ("given" %in% names(x$author)) {

          if (!is.na(x$author$given[j])) {

            given <- as.character(
              x$author$given[j]
            )
          }
        }

        if ("family" %in% names(x$author)) {

          if (!is.na(x$author$family[j])) {

            family <- as.character(
              x$author$family[j]
            )
          }
        }

        noms[j] <- trimws(
          paste(
            given,
            family
          )
        )
      }

      noms <- noms[
        noms != ""
      ]


      if (length(noms) == 1) {

        auteurs <- noms[1]

      } else if (length(noms) == 2) {

        auteurs <- paste(
          noms,
          collapse = " & "
        )

      } else if (length(noms) > 2) {

        auteurs <- paste0(
          paste(
            noms[-length(noms)],
            collapse = ", "
          ),
          " & ",
          noms[length(noms)]
        )
      }
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Journal
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    journal <- ""

    if (!is.null(x$`container-title`) &&
        length(x$`container-title`) > 0) {

      journal <- as.character(
        x$`container-title`[1]
      )
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Volume
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    volume <- get_scalar(
      x$volume
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Numéro
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    issue <- get_scalar(
      x$issue
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Pages ou numéro d'article
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    pages <- ""

    if (!is.null(x$page)) {

      pages <- get_scalar(
        x$page
      )
    }

    if (pages == "" &&
        !is.null(x$`article-number`)) {

      pages <- get_scalar(
        x$`article-number`
      )
    }

    pages <- clean_pages(
      pages
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Construction de la référence
    #
    # 58: 121–131
    #
    # ou
    #
    # 28(2): 337–360
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    details <- ""

    if (volume != "") {

      details <- volume
    }


    if (issue != "") {

      if (details != "") {

        details <- paste0(
          details,
          "(",
          issue,
          ")"
        )

      } else {

        details <- paste0(
          "(",
          issue,
          ")"
        )
      }
    }


    if (pages != "") {

      if (details != "") {

        details <- paste0(
          details,
          ": ",
          pages
        )

      } else {

        details <- pages
      }
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Résultat
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    list(
      titre = titre,
      auteurs = auteurs,
      journal = journal,
      details = details,
      doi = doi
    )


  }, error = function(e) {

    return(NULL)

  })
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Affichage d'une publication
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print_publication <- function(current) {


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Informations locales
  # Elles servent de fallback si aucun DOI n'est disponible
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  lien <- ifelse(
    is.na(current$Lien),
    "",
    as.character(current$Lien)
  )


  auteurs <- ifelse(
    is.na(current$AllAuteurs),
    "",
    as.character(current$AllAuteurs)
  )


  journal <- ifelse(
    is.na(current$Journal2),
    "",
    as.character(current$Journal2)
  )


  pages <- ifelse(
    is.na(current$Pages),
    "",
    as.character(current$Pages)
  )


  doi <- ifelse(
    is.na(current$DOI),
    "",
    trimws(
      as.character(current$DOI)
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Si DOI :
  # récupération des métadonnées Crossref
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  cr <- NULL

  if (doi != "" &&
      doi != "NA") {

    cr <- get_crossref(
      doi
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DOI trouvé dans Crossref
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is.null(cr) &&
      cr$titre != "") {


    doi_url <- paste0(
      "https://doi.org/",
      doi
    )


    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-item'>\n"
    )


    # Titre

    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-title'><a href='",
      doi_url,
      "' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'>",
      cr$titre,
      "</a></div>\n",
      sep = ""
    )


    # Auteurs

    if (cr$auteurs != "") {

      cat(
        "<div class='cara-publication-authors'>",
        cr$auteurs,
        "</div>\n",
        sep = ""
      )
    }


    # Journal + volume + numéro + pages

    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-journal'><em>",
      cr$journal,
      "</em>",
      sep = ""
    )


    if (cr$details != "") {

      cat(
        " ",
        cr$details,
        sep = ""
      )
    }


    cat(
      "</div>\n"
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Dimensions
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-metrics'>\n"
    )


    cat(
      "<span class='__dimensions_badge_embed__' data-doi='",
      doi,
      "' data-style='small_rectangle'></span>\n",
      sep = ""
    )


    cat(
      "</div>\n"
    )


    cat(
      "</div>\n"
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Pas de DOI ou Crossref ne trouve pas le DOI
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  } else {


    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-item'>\n"
    )


    # Titre provenant de Publis.Rda

    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-title'>",
      lien,
      "</div>\n",
      sep = ""
    )


    # Auteurs

    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-authors'>",
      auteurs,
      "</div>\n",
      sep = ""
    )


    # Journal

    cat(
      "<div class='cara-publication-journal'><em>",
      journal,
      "</em> ",
      pages,
      "</div>\n",
      sep = ""
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Si le DOI existe mais que Crossref est temporairement
    # indisponible, on affiche quand même Dimensions
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (doi != "" &&
        doi != "NA") {


      cat(
        "<div class='cara-publication-metrics'>\n"
      )


      cat(
        "<span class='__dimensions_badge_embed__' data-doi='",
        doi,
        "' data-style='small_rectangle'></span>\n",
        sep = ""
      )


      cat(
        "</div>\n"
      )
    }


    cat(
      "</div>\n"
    )
  }
}
```

# Publications

## Publications récentes

::: {.cara-publication-list}

```{r echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

publis <- Publis %>%
  filter(
    Année >= 2019,
    Etat != "Projet",
    is.na(Exclu)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Année)
  )


if (nrow(publis) > 0) {

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(publis))) {

    print_publication(
      publis[i, ]
    )
  }
}
```
